messages.content: It is deeply painful when recovery feels impossible because the source of the stress never stops. Feeling trapped in a perpetual performance is profoundly exhausting, and wanting it all to quiet down is a completely understandable desire. If you feel overwhelmed, please know there are people who want to listen without judgment; reaching out to a crisis line can offer immediate relief from the noise.
